exposure: Early-onset pre-eclampsia with severe features (EOPES) before 34 weeks' gestation
cohort: 168 patients with EOPES before 34 weeks' gestation at Tygerberg Hospital, Cape Town, between January 1 and June 30, 2017
finding: In patients with EOPES before 34 weeks' gestation, 36% had successful IoL resulting in vaginal delivery, with a higher likelihood of success in cases with normal UADs and EFW >3rd centile.
